extracted.intended_audience: readers and scholars of classical natural history / Latin texts (e.g., students of Pliny and historians of science)
extracted.subtask_description: An OCR'd Latin excerpt from Pliny's Natural History (De Animalibus) giving descriptive observations and causal explanations about animals, their morphology, colors, behaviors, and habitats. The page is a primary-source literary/natural-history text, not a modern evaluation rubric.
